# Tulip Electronics Inc.

> Canadian manufacturer of replacement memory boards for legacy Fanuc, Yasnac and
> Mitsubishi CNC controls, since 1984.
> Kitchener, Ontario, Canada · cnc@tulipmemory.com · 289-389-6117

Tulip Electronics designs and manufactures new (not refurbished) replacement and upgrade
memory boards for legacy CNC controls: Fanuc 6/9/11/12 (bubble memory), Fanuc 16A/18A,
Fanuc 16B/16C/18B/18C, Fanuc 16B FROM/flash, Fanuc 15A/15B, Fanuc 16i/18i (iA); Yasnac
MX2/LX2, MX3/LX3 and i80; and the Mitsubishi 500 series (Mazak PLUS). The FANRAM product
line was invented by founder Bill Peiman. Every board carries a 3-year warranty with free
lifetime technical support from the original engineer. Customers still run FANRAM boards
shipped in the 1990s. Fanuc 0i, "Mate" and iB-series (post-2007) controls are not served.

## Products
- [Full catalogue](https://tulipmemory.com/products/): every board, price, capacity and OEM part-number cross-reference
- [Fanuc control finder](https://tulipmemory.com/controls/fanuc/): FANRAM/FAN16/F15/Fan-i boards by control platform
- [Yasnac control finder](https://tulipmemory.com/controls/yasnac/): YASRAM boards for MX2/LX2, MX3/LX3, i80
- [Mitsubishi control finder](https://tulipmemory.com/controls/mitsubishi/): MITRAM500 for the 500 series (Mazak PLUS)

## Services
- [Services overview](https://tulipmemory.com/services/)
- [Control retrofits](https://tulipmemory.com/services/retrofit/): modernize a legacy control while keeping the machine
- [In-person & remote service](https://tulipmemory.com/services/service/): diagnosis, repair, parameter recovery, board-level repair
- [Technical support](https://tulipmemory.com/services/support/): free phone/email support for the life of every Tulip product
- [Consultation](https://tulipmemory.com/services/consultation/): upgrade, retrofit, or replace — a straight answer
